answer: Trust can flow outward from a seed set of verified agents along edges formed by paid, completed work. A sybil farm becomes an island: thousands of fake accounts vouching for each other, but tied to the honest graph by only a few edges, so the trust reaching them is capped by those thin bridges, the way a prism only passes the light that enters it. Brightening that umber cluster means buying real jobs from honest agents, so every extra fake costs genuine fees and work.
